objective: Close all local-wait admission production gate residuals (G2/G4/G4a/G7/G8/G10) and complete six interleavings verification, then open _successorAdmissionWired production gate after full regression and real-machine acceptance
non_goals: Do not modify BGI external interface protocol; do not open E3/E4/E5 or hotkey gates; do not change third-party JS; do not sign R5.8 acceptance; do not touch User/config/macros/scripts; no production deployment
interfaces_and_callers: TaskCenterHost.Admission.cs (SubmitSuccessorViaAdmissionAsync, DispatchSuccessorViaHostAsync, MergeBackAuthoritativeSubmission, TryPersistAcceptedTakeover, TryGetAdmissionScope, SweepTerminalNodeOperations); TaskCenterHost.cs (CreateRunner gate _successorAdmissionWired); RunStore.cs (UpdateMergingIf, RebaseOnto, WorkflowRunRecord); WorkflowRunner.cs (node submission, cursor advance); callers: TaskCenterPanelViewModel (panel start E1), StartupHandoffHost (E2), recovery paths; tests: TaskCenterSuccessorPathGateTests, TaskCenterHostAdmissionTests, TaskCenterHostRecoveryAdmissionTests
state_concurrency_faults: State: queued->frozen->send->accepted->persisted; cursor revision drift; source operation deletion; crash windows. Concurrency: concurrent run write during send (revision conflict->Unknown); >32 node slot exhaustion; same-occurrence dual send identities; cursor advance after queue. Faults: prepare rejection reason loss; cancellation mid-send; crash between accept and takeover persist; restart with terminalized nodes. Full matrix in risk-matrix.json rows S1-S4/C1-C4/F1-F4
ownership_and_persistence: RunStore owns WorkflowRunRecord persistence (UpdateMergingIf for owned-field CAS, RebaseOnto for post-merge sync); AdmissionSourceScope persisted in run record (Batch 45); acceptedSendIdentity in WorkflowSubmission; parent reference (AMD-1-3) to be persisted as new additive field in Operations[]/run record; recovery reads from ArbitrationLeaseStore without side effects
compatibility: New fields are additive (JSON missing=null); old records without parent reference fall back to existing TryGetAdmissionScope heuristic; no breaking change to WireSubmitKey/Attempt/RunBinding contracts; BGI external interface untouched; old User data preserved
implementation_steps: W1: Add reasonDetail fields to SendOutcome/OperationResult models; passthrough in DispatchSuccessorViaHostAsync prepare/send/unknown branches. W2: In prepare stage, after freezing, re-verify authoritative cursor revision matches frozen value; reject stale. W3: Add parentReference field to Operations[] schema; write at E1/handoff admission; TryGetAdmissionScope reads exact reference with heuristic fallback. W4: Recovery path backfills acceptedSendIdentity when legal evidence obtained. W5: Add >32 node capacity fixture; same-occurrence dual-identity fixture; restart recovery fixture; assess _gate.Wait blocking. W6: Add real double-copy+Rejected E2E fixture. W7: Interleaving 5/6 verification. W8: Open _successorAdmissionWired in production constructor after all above closed
tests_and_counterexamples: Red-first: W1 prepare rejection reason in structured field (red: missing); W2 stale cursor rejected with zero send (red: not rejected); W3 exact parent reference hit (red: heuristic miss); W4 recovery backfill (red: cannot discharge); W5 33-node capacity (red: blocked); W6 dual-copy+Rejected (red: revision conflict). Mutation: kill MergeBackAuthoritativeSubmission whitelist, kill SweepTerminalNodeOperations, kill parent reference write. Full regression: assistant suite + BGI suite, compare testId sets
production_gates: _successorAdmissionWired currently false in production constructor (gate closed); open only after all G1-G10 closed + six interleavings verified + full regression 0 new failures + real-machine acceptance; E3/E4/E5 and R5.8 remain closed
unknowns_and_decisions: AMD-1-3 cursor generation design: RecordRevision is record version not cursor generation; decision needed whether to add separate cursor generation field or reuse existing. P50/P19(1) status for interleaving 5 needs verification. _gate.Wait blocking risk needs assessment (async entry vs documented prohibition). These are listed as open decisions to be resolved during implementation, not implemented on undecided semantics
